definitions.gloss: detector; sensor (esp. for fire, smoke, heat)
definitions.explanation: A device that detects smoke, heat, gas, motion or similar and triggers an alarm or signal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{火災|かさい}→火災：02561_kasai⟧{感知器|かんちき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}った→鳴る：01143_naru⟧。
⟦{天井|てんじょう}→天井：05008_tenjou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{煙|けむり}→煙：02705_kemuri⟧{感知器|かんちき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a smoke detector on the ceiling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{湯気|ゆげ}→湯気：03991_yuge⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{感知器|かんちき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{反応|はんのう}→反応：04812_hannou⟧し、⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧{中|じゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{響|ひび}いた→響く：00099_hibiku⟧。
examples.english: Steam from cooking set off the detector, and an alarm rang through the building.

notes:
A technical and safety-notice word, especially in fire prevention (⟦{消防|しょうぼう}→消防：03241_shoubou⟧). In homes the alarm unit is usually called {住宅用|じゅうたくよう}⟦{火災|かさい}→火災：02561_kasai⟧{警報器|けいほうき}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{火災|かさい}→火災：02561_kasai⟧{感知器|かんちき}: fire detector
- ⟦{煙|けむり}→煙：02705_kemuri⟧{感知器|かんちき}: smoke detector
- ⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧{感知器|かんちき}: heat detector
- {感知器|かんちき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{作動|さどう}→作動：11692_sadou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: the detector is triggered

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦センサー→センサー：29781_sensaa⟧: sensor; the everyday word for any sensing device
- ⟦{探知機|たんちき}→探知機：31216_tanchiki⟧: a detector for finding hidden things (⟦{金属|きんぞく}→金属：02645_kinzoku⟧⟦{探知機|たんちき}→探知機：31216_tanchiki⟧, metal detector)
- {警報器|けいほうき}: an alarm
